header: Presentational UI for the Announcement Manager Facility (Modular Facility Kit). I match the visual language of the Employee Manager, PAX Directory Editor, Holiday Manager, and Circular Manager: glass cards, live validation, underline tabs, consistent header inline layout, and NonExecutive delegation cards.

doc: This is the PDF part of the publish / edit form. Nothing is uploaded here: it only chooses. `chosen` is the file picked now; `current` is the PDF the announcement already has (when editing); `removeCurrent` says it is to be taken off. A PDF may stand alone, because I made the body text optional.

doc: This shows how the announcement went into the search index: its PDF (read from its own text, or by AI where a page had none; searchable inside, or not and why) and its text. A part that is not in order says so, and one button prepares the announcement again.
